ground.alt: American woodcock standing in pine-needle litter: a plump, short-legged bird with a very long straight bill, large dark eye set high and far back on the head, and mottled brown, gray and black plumage that matches the leaves

flight.alt: Dark silhouette of an American woodcock flying against a dusky gray sky, long bill pointing forward and rounded wings blurred by motion
flight.captionNote: Photographed in flight at dusk in March. It is not documented as a display flight, so it is shown as the silhouette to expect, not as a sky-dance photo.
